edges.reason: createWrapper is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier before any privileged state change.
owner state variable is read and passed to the new Wrapper constructor.
resolver address is read and forwarded to the new Wrapper constructor.
token parameter is forwarded into the Wrapper constructor.
currencyKey parameter is forwarded into the Wrapper constructor.
synthContractName parameter is forwarded into the Wrapper constructor.
deployed Wrapper instance is stored in the local variable.
factoryFlexibleStorage() is called to register the new wrapper.
newly deployed wrapper.rebuildCache() is invoked immediately after deployment.
feesEscrowed() is consulted for the amount to distribute.
amountSUSD local is assigned from feesEscrowed().
factorySynthsUSD() resolver lookup is used for the sUSD transfer.
feePool() resolver lookup provides FEE_ADDRESS and recordFeePaid.
external sUSD transfer executes before feePool.recordFeePaid updates accounting.
feePool.recordFeePaid external call records the escrowed fees.
transfer success flag is stored in the local variable.
amountIn parameter drives the mint calculation.
msg.sender allowance and balance are validated before minting.
notPaused modifier reads the paused state variable.
issuanceActive modifier calls systemStatus().requireIssuanceActive().
capacity() is called to bound the mintable amount.
calculateMintFee() computes the fee for actualAmountIn.
currentCapacity local holds the capacity() result.
actualAmountIn local is bounded by currentCapacity.
mintAmount local is derived from the fee calculation.
feeAmountTarget local comes from calculateMintFee.
negative flag local comes from calculateMintFee.
reserve tokens are pulled from the user through _safeTransferFrom.
_mint is invoked after the reserve token transfer succeeds.
exchangeRates().rateIsInvalid(currencyKey) is checked before minting.
amountIn parameter drives the burn calculation.
msg.sender synth balance is validated before burning.
notPaused modifier reads the paused state variable.
issuanceActive modifier calls systemStatus().requireIssuanceActive().
synth() resolver lookup is used for the caller balance check.
totalIssuedSynths() is required to be greater than zero.
calculateBurnFee(targetSynthIssued) computes the burn fee.
burnFee local is assigned from calculateBurnFee.
burnAmount local is derived from targetSynthIssued and the fee.
amountOut local is computed with multiply/divideDecimal of the burn fee rate.
negative flag local comes from calculateBurnFee.
reserve tokens are returned to the user through _safeTransferFrom.
_burn is invoked after the reserve token transfer succeeds.
amount parameter is issued to the caller.
reserves local is assigned from getReserves().
excessAmount local is computed from reserves and targetSynthIssued.
excessAmountUsd local comes from exchangeRates().effectiveValue.
getReserves() is called to compute the reserve excess.
exchangeRates() is used to value the excess reserves in sUSD.
synth() is used to issue synths to msg.sender.
synth().issue external call executes before targetSynthIssued is updated.
synthsUSD() is used to escrow fees to the wrapper factory.
wrapperFactory() resolver lookup receives the escrowed sUSD.
_setTargetSynthIssued is called to update the accounting target.
amount parameter is burned from the caller.
reserves local is assigned from getReserves().
excessAmount local is computed from reserves and targetSynthIssued.
excessAmountUsd local comes from exchangeRates().effectiveValue.
getReserves() is called to compute the reserve excess.
exchangeRates() is used to value the excess reserves in sUSD.
synth() is used to burn synths from msg.sender.
synth().burn external call executes before targetSynthIssued is updated.
synthsUSD() is used to escrow fees to the wrapper factory.
_setTargetSynthIssued is called to update the accounting target.
_targetSynthIssued parameter becomes the new stored target.
signed difference between the new and stored targetSynthIssued is computed before assignment.
debtCache() is called to record the excluded debt change.
_tokenAddress parameter is the target of the raw call.
_from parameter is encoded into the transferFrom calldata.
_to parameter is encoded into the transferFrom calldata.
_value parameter is encoded into the transferFrom calldata.
raw assembly call() to the token address executes with no reentrancy guard.
ERC20 transferFrom is executed on the token contract before accounting completes.
capacity() derives the remaining capacity from getReserves().
token.balanceOf(address(this)) reads the reserve token state variable.
amount parameter is used in the fee calculation.
amount parameter is used in the fee calculation.
msg.sender must equal nominatedOwner to accept ownership.
nominatedOwner state variable is read and compared.
owner state variable is reassigned to the nominated owner.
nominateNewOwner is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
_owner parameter is stored as the nominated owner.
nominatedOwner state variable is written.
msg.sender is compared against the stored owner.
owner state variable is read inside the require statement.
setPaused is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
_paused parameter determines the new pause flag value.
paused state variable is read and written.
block.timestamp (now) is written to lastPauseTime when pausing.
resolver is invoked to fetch required addresses.
isWrapper reads the flexible storage registry.

totalIssuedSynths() values the targetSynthIssued state variable.
currencyKey is used for the effective value conversion.
exchangeRates().effectiveValue performs the sUSD conversion.
